Anima Workflow - Easy to Use

This workflow was created with the intention to take the essentials and compress them into an easy to use format.

Includes

  • 2 KSampler passes

  • Detailer(SEGS)

  • USDU (Ultimate SD Upscaler)

  • Preview Section
